purpose: Quality and fusion integration: locate conditions, expressions and support; no new worker labels, difficulty score or formal protocol

join_contract.record: object_id; preserve worker_id, image_id, condition, origin, reference_id and eligibility
join_contract.team: pool_id + team_key, member_object_ids/member_workers; exact repeated team draws are not independent teams
join_contract.image_conditions: reference_id; reference traits depend on this exact target, not merely image_id
join_contract.reference_comparisons: Inherited formal quality and current difficulty-target binding; no reference replacement
join_contract.gt_free_expression: Non-OOS independent expression can include reference-problem rows; no restoration of quality/voting eligibility

claims.adoption: Condition association with expression simplification; not causal difficulty
claims.condition: ordinary Manual, formal current target, six effective reference turns
claims.limit: H is geometric self-occlusion under opaque solid-wall assumption; reduced is fewer effective turns than declared reference, not semantic omission truth

claims.adoption: Same-person response and same-image person differences at narrow/weak boundary cues
claims.condition: b8cTxDM8gDG-07 versus jtcxE69GiFV-13; each image has its own exact six-turn reference
claims.limit: Different rooms, not controlled visibility intervention; photo cue interpretation is not a final semantic wall adjudication

claims.adoption: Common-target speed-mixture losses vary by structural condition
claims.condition: new ordinary Manual, n=5, four fast and one retained slow versus five slow; common images across worker domains
claims.limit: Same target images but different member sets and baseline levels across domains; missing quality is not zero; group building sets differ; not speed causal effect

claims.adoption: Historical overall/difficult Q, target individual Q and local team contribution are distinct
claims.condition: Actual four replaced fast/slow pairs only; fifth retained slow excluded
claims.limit: No new difficult-expert labels; inherited out-of-target-building histories, missing remains missing; repeated pair exposures not extra people

claims.adoption: Doorway extent/scale dispersion, separately from correctness
claims.condition: GT-free independent Manual expressions; one per worker/image, at least three persons/image
claims.limit: Area includes scale and localization; not confirmed scope disagreement or scope-response correctness

cases.mechanism: two reference turns: 3 votes to 2, fixed threshold=3; six to four fused nodes
all four nodes keep five votes; short-edge location sensitivity
cases.limit: Explicit reference-edge angle differs from native dir orthogonality regularity; quality decomposition owned by quality topic

cases.mechanism: same mixture ratio, Q98.625 versus53.062; three common members, two-person composition differs

adoption_limits.manual: Main condition evidence; new mixture cohort separate from old whole-expression cohort; counts not summed
adoption_limits.semi: 18 allQ images /10 buildings, no highQ domain; do not transfer Manual mechanism statistics or fit personnel classes here
adoption_limits.doorway: HighQ mixture only3 images/2 buildings; no structural speed-mixture generalization
adoption_limits.gt: GT-problem expressions retained, correctness reference gates unchanged
adoption_limits.time: Inherited same-source active/reported labor cost only; no raw-log replay or actual parallel delivery inference
